e-service quality dimensions have a significant effect on consumer purchase intention.
e-service quality has significant positive impact on consumer satisfaction.
e-service quality has a significant impact on customer satisfaction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What are the dimensions of e-service?
how the quality of the e-service provided by a web site can be measured, and what impact this quality has on the customer’s satisfaction with the web site and their purchase intentions.
identifying factors that affect e-service quality and the effect of e-service quality on customer satisfaction and intention to purchase.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
e-service quality dimensions, such as web site design, responsiveness, reliability, trust, and personalization have a positive impact on consumer purchase behaviour.
e-service quality has a positive impact on overall service quality.
the e-service quality has a positive effect on the overall service quality, the customer satisfaction and the purchase intention.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the e-service quality dimensions have a strong relationship with customer satisfaction and purchase intention.
e-service quality is a significant predictor of overall service quality, which is a significant predictor for consumer’s satisfaction, which in turn is a predictor of purchase intention.
e-service quality is a multidimensional construct and it has significant impact on consumer satisfaction and purchase intentions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
e-service quality dimensions have a positive and significant effect on overall satisfaction and purchase intention.
e-commerce companies can improve their service quality by focusing on the design of their web site.
